qa: Yes, a Digimon with the names gained from the [All Turns] effect is considered to be moved. For example, if this card with a level 3 [Agumon] in digivolution cards moves from the breeding area to the battle area, a Digimon with the names [Greymon] and [Agumon] is considered to be moved.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon's name is [Koromon], this Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon. [All Turns] This Digimon gains all the names of level 3 or lower cards in its digivolution cards. [On Deletion] You may play 1 Tamer card with [Tai Kamiya] or [Kari Kamiya] in its name from your hand without paying the cost, or hatch in your breeding area.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [On Deletion] You may play 1 Tamer card with [Tai Kamiya] or [Kari Kamiya] in its name from your hand without paying the cost, or hatch in your breeding area.
